dirs.name: access_tools
dirs.title: MapBiomas Fire Access Tools
dirs.desc: This directory, access_tools/, is dedicated to scripts, APIs, interfaces, and automated tools that facilitate access to MapBiomas Fire data and analytical resources.

dirs.name: global_analises
dirs.title: global_analises — Monitor global de fogo
dirs.desc: Painel estático com ranking mensal de área queimada, focos de calor e emissões por país e por estado/província, no mundo inteiro.

dirs.name: mapbiomas_fire_collections
collection_04
01-pre_classification
dirs.title: 01. Pre-Classification
dirs.desc: This directory is responsible for preparing the datasets and essential tools required to initiate the mapping of burned area scars.

dirs.name: 03-post_classification
dirs.title: 03. Pós-Classificação
dirs.desc: Esta etapa consolida os resultados da classificação bruta, aplicando filtros de qualidade e integrando com mapas de uso e cobertura da terra (MapBiomas).

dirs.name: 04-statistics
dirs.title: 04. Statistics
dirs.desc: This folder contains the scripts responsible for exporting statistics from MapBiomas Fire Collection 4.

dirs.title: Collection 04 - MapBiomas Fire
dirs.desc: This directory contains the complete pipeline of scripts and processing workflows for Collection 04 and its subsequent update, Collection 04.1, of the MapBiomas Fire project.

dirs.name: collection_05
01-pre_classification
dirs.title: Collection 05 - 01. Pre-classification
dirs.desc: This directory contains the scripts and supporting tools used to prepare the datasets required for the initial burned-area mapping workflow.

dirs.title: Collection 05 - MapBiomas Fire
dirs.desc: This directory contains the scripts and processing workflows for Collection 05 and Collection 05.1 of the MapBiomas Fire project.

dirs.title: MapBiomas Fire - Data Collections
dirs.desc: This directory centralizes the scripts and processing workflows organized by historical and current MapBiomas Fire collection versions.

dirs.name: mapbiomas_fire_monitor
version_01
dirs.title: MapBiomas Fire Monitor – Fire Trajectory and Origin (version_01)
dirs.desc: Monthly product that groups active-fire detections (hotspots) into fire events with a spatio-temporal DBSCAN, estimates how each event spread over time, and combines this with the monthly burned-area scars of the MapBiomas Fire Monitor. It outputs a 30 m trajectory map and the likely ignition…

dirs.name: export_and_vectorization
dirs.title: MapBiomas Export & Publish
dirs.desc: Pipeline multipais/multitematico para exportar dados do catalogo MapBiomas (originalmente o monitor de fogo, hoje expandido para muitos paises, temas e produtos): exportacao do GEE, mosaico, publicacao no bucket publico e limpeza do temp. A vetorizacao e uma etapa opcional (analise adicional)…

dirs.desc: Scripts for the continuous monitoring of fire in Brazil: products derived from the monthly MapBiomas Fire Monitor and tools to export and distribute its data.

_base
i18n
dirs.title: i18n
dirs.desc: Shared interface texts in three languages: pt-BR.json, en.json, es.json. The three files have exactly the same keys.

dirs.name: logos
dirs.title: Logos
dirs.desc: MapBiomas_ are the general MapBiomas Fire logos (collections, documents); Monitor_ are for the Fire Monitor. This folder is the single source; tools that must open standalone (static HTML) keep a copy next to the file.

dirs.title: utils/_base — shared standards
dirs.desc: Single source of logos, UI strings (i18n), documentation templates and coding rules for the tools in utils/. For the Brazil team and the countries of the MapBiomas Fire network.

dirs.name: fire_dashboard
dirs.title: MapBiomas Fire · Dashboard
dirs.desc: 🌎 Eight countries: Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Paraguay, Peru and Indonesia. Pick the country and the language at the top of the page (or open a link such as .../dashboard/#pais=peru&lang=en). Languages: Portuguese, Spanish and English for every country, plus Bahasa Indonesia…

dirs.name: fire_legends
dirs.title: MapBiomas Fire · Legends
dirs.desc: Consult the legends and palettes of every MapBiomas Fire collection published so far (per country, collection and product) and export them as GEE code, CSV, JSON, SVG/PNG or HEX lists (with pixel values, or comma-separated).

dirs.name: fire_monitor_highlights
dirs.desc: Landing page with both countries: https://mapbiomas.github.io/brazil-fire/fire_monitor_highlights/

dirs.title: MapBiomas Fire · Repository map
dirs.desc: Browsable map of this repository for users and developers: the main areas, every folder with the description taken from its README.md, its files (with Colab links for notebooks), what kind of code it holds, and which folders are published apps or legacy/production versions. Interface in…

dirs.name: fire_showcase
dirs.title: MapBiomas Fire · Showcase
dirs.desc: Root page of this repository's GitHub Pages. Two tabs: Apps (cards with a screenshot of every published app, filters by tag, and the main Colab notebooks and tools) and Repository map (the fire_repo_map app embedded). Interface in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

dirs.name: mapbiomas_fire_export_and_vectorization
dirs.title: MapBiomas Fogo — Export & Vectorization
dirs.desc: Pipeline multipais para exportar as colecoes do MapBiomas Fogo: exportacao do GEE, mosaico, publicacao no bucket publico e limpeza do temp. A vetorizacao e uma etapa opcional para produtos vetorizaveis. Vale para todas as colecoes de fogo (anuais, mensais etc.), nao so uma.

dirs.name: mapbiomas_gif_factory
fire_legends_source
dirs.title: Fire legend snapshot
dirs.desc: These CSVs are copied unchanged from utils/fire_legends in https://github.com/mapbiomas/brazil-fire at commit ad70d566e5676402c597339d10907e1fdf2163f9. They include registry.csv and the legend CSVs. Run python build_vera_fire_legends.py from the package root to reproduce the packaged JSON.

dirs.name: theme_legends
dirs.title: Provisional registry of non-fire styles
dirs.desc: This local inventory reproduces selected styles from visualization.source.yaml, a pinned copy of the earlier Factory's config/visualization.yaml. It is not an official legend and does not validate whether the styles are suitable for any data. Links to country, collection, asset, and processor,…

dirs.title: MapBiomas GIF Factory — pilot
dirs.desc: A prototype for producing map GIFs from multiband Earth Engine images in Google Colab. The initial catalog includes experimental fire products for Brazil and Peru; assets, permissions, legends, and results must be checked before production use.

dirs.title: MapBiomas Fire · Utils
dirs.desc: Supporting tools for the MapBiomas Fire network. Each folder is independent and has its own README.
